name: @agentpickup/mcp

tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find agentPickup shops to order from: near a point (lat/lng), in a suburb or city (place), or selling something (query). Returns each shop's shop_url, pickup address, hours, whether it's open now, distance, and matching menu items.

query.description: What the user wants, e.g. "AA batteries", "flowers" or "sourdough". Leave out to list everything.

place.description: A suburb, street or city to match against shop addresses, e.g. "Surry Hills".

lat.description: Where the user is: latitude. Send with lng.

lng.description: Where the user is: longitude. Send with lat.

radius_km.description: With lat/lng: how far to look. Default 10.

open_now.description: Only shops open now (shops without listed hours stay in).

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: What the shop sells (item ids and prices, with photos, dietary labels, allergens, what's sold out, and what's in stock where the shop's POS counts it), where to collect, and which payments it takes. In chat apps that show cards, the menu appears as a card with the photos.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: ask_about_shop
tools.description: Answer a question about a shop that its menu doesn't: dietary needs and allergies (gluten-free, vegan, nuts), reviews, opening hours, where it is, parking, wait times, prices. Use it whenever the user asks something like that about a shop. Send the question in a few words, without names or other personal details. It answers from what the shop has said, says plainly what the shop hasn't, and tells the shop which topics people ask about (never the question itself).

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

question.description: The question in a few words, e.g. "gluten-free options?" or "is there parking?"

tools.name: create_pickup_order
tools.description: Create an order to collect in person. Returns the order id, total and a claim (keep it); pay it with pay_order. The shop emails the pickup pass to `email` once it's paid, and where the chat shows cards the order shows as one that becomes the pass. Where the shop takes cards, `payment: "card"` returns a checkout link for the user to pay on instead.

options.description: The ids of this line's chosen options from get_shop (a size, a colour, an add-on). Ask for a required choice that has no default.

email.description: The user's email. The pickup pass goes here too.

name.description: Name for the order, shown to staff

dietary_note.description: The user's dietary needs for the shop, in their words (an allergy, an intolerance), where get_shop says it takes dietary notes. Only what the user said; leave it out if they said nothing.

pickup_at.description: When the user wants to collect, if not as soon as possible: a time in the shop's own time zone (get_shop gives its local time) like "17:30" or "5:30pm" (today, or tomorrow once it has passed), or an ISO time. It must be when the shop is open, within 7 days. Leave it out for as soon as possible.

payment.description: Who pays: agent (USDC over x402, or a test payment at a test shop), card (the user pays on a checkout link), or test (where the shop takes test payments: the whole flow with no money moving). Default: agent where the shop takes it, else card.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Get the payment details for an order made with create_pickup_order. No wallet is set up in this server, so it pays nothing: for an x402 order it returns the USDC price and pay link for another x402 client to pay; for a card order, the checkout link for the user to pay on.

order_id.description: The order id create_pickup_order returned, like "ord_7HkQ2mXc9aRt".

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Check where an order is up to, when the user asks if it's paid or ready, or before telling them to go and collect. Returns its status (waiting for payment, paid, being made, ready to collect, collected, expired or cancelled), and the checkout link while it's unpaid. Works with the order id alone. With the claim, a paid order's pass comes back as well and the chat's order card updates. When the user only wants their QR or pickup code again, use get_pickup_pass instead.

order_id.description: The order id create_pickup_order returned, like "ord_7HkQ2mXc9aRt".

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order. With it, a paid order's pass comes back too.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: set_dietary_note
tools.description: Add or change the dietary note on an order before it's paid (an allergy, an intolerance, in the user's words), at a shop that takes dietary notes. An empty note removes it. The order's card shows it within a few seconds. Once the order is paid it's with the shop already: the user tells staff at the counter instead.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order.

note.description: The note, only what the user said. Empty to remove it.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: cancel_pickup_order
tools.description: Cancel a pickup order when the user asks, with the claim create_pickup_order returned. An unpaid order just closes. A paid one can be cancelled until the shop starts making it, and what was paid goes back the way it was paid (a card refund can take a few business days to show). Once the shop has started it, or it's ready, the user asks staff at the counter instead.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: get_pickup_pass
tools.description: Get the pickup pass again for a paid order, when the user asks for their QR, pickup code or pass link (lost the email, closed the card). Returns the pass link, the six-character pickup code and the QR, shown as the pass card. Needs the claim create_pickup_order returned. An unpaid order has no pass yet: to see where an order is up to, use order_status instead.

order_id.description: The order id create_pickup_order returned, like "ord_7HkQ2mXc9aRt".

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order. With it, a paid order's pass comes back too.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: share_agentpickup
tools.description: A QR code and link the user can share so friends can add agentPickup to Claude, ChatGPT or Grok and order too. Use when the user asks how to share agentPickup, invite friends, or get others using it. Name a shop to share it with that shop picked.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: start_group_order
tools.description: Start a group order (a team lunch, an office order) at a shop, when the user wants to order together with others now. Returns a code to share: each person's agent joins with it and pays for their own items. When it closes, the shop gets one combined order and the organiser is emailed its pickup QR. To share agentPickup itself with a friend, use share_agentpickup instead.

organiser_email.description: Where the group's pickup QR goes

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: join_group_order
tools.description: Add the user's items to a group order with its code. Returns the order id; pay it with pay_order before the group closes. The organiser collects everything, so the user gets a receipt, not a QR.

options.description: The ids of this line's chosen options from get_shop (a size, a colour, an add-on). Ask for a required choice that has no default.

dietary_note.description: The user's dietary needs for the shop, in their words (an allergy, an intolerance), where get_shop says it takes dietary notes. Only what the user said; leave it out if they said nothing.

email.description: The user's email, for their receipt

name.description: The user's name, shown to staff on their items

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: group_order_status
tools.description: Check a group order by its code, when the user asks who's in, what's been ordered or whether it has closed. Returns each person's name, items and whether they've paid, the total paid so far, when it closes, and, once it has closed, the status of the shop's combined order (paid, ready or collected). Anyone with the code can check it; it changes nothing. To add the user's own items, use join_group_order; to close it early as the organiser, use close_group_order.

code.description: The group order's code, from start_group_order or as the organiser shared it.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: close_group_order
tools.description: Close a group order early, as its organiser. Unpaid shares are left out; the shop gets the rest as one order.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

instructions:
agentPickup lets you buy things online for the user to collect in person.
0. find_shops (when available): shops near the user that sell what they want. Pass a shop's shop_url to the other tools.
1. get_shop: see what the shop sells, its pickup location and how it takes payment.
2. create_pickup_order: needs the user's email; the shop emails the pickup pass there too. It returns a claim:
   keep it with the order id. Pass an item's chosen options (get_shop lists them) as option ids, and the user's
   dietary note as dietary_note where the shop takes them; set_dietary_note changes it before payment. pickup_at
   orders for later ("for 5:30"), when the shop is open; leave it out for as soon as possible.
   cancel_pickup_order (with the claim) cancels an order the shop hasn't started, refunded the way it was paid.
3. pay_order: pays in USDC over x402 from the wallet set up here; with none, it hands back the pay link for the user's
   own x402 wallet. Where the shop takes cards, payment: "card" on
   create_pickup_order gives a checkout link for the user to pay on instead. Where it takes test payments (get_shop says
   so), payment: "test" runs the whole flow with no money moving. Confirm the items and total with the user first.
4. The pass: where the chat shows cards, the order appears as a card that becomes the pickup pass (QR and code)
   once it's paid and keeps itself up to date until it's collected. Otherwise give the user the pass link and pickup
   code. They show the QR at the counter, or say the code, to collect.
get_pickup_pass (with the claim) fetches the pass again; order_status (with the claim) says whether it's ready.
share_agentpickup: when the user wants to share agentPickup itself, invite a friend or get friends using it, shows a
QR and link for them. That isn't a group order: start_group_order is only for ordering together at one shop.
Group orders (a team lunch, an office order): start_group_order gives a code to share; each person's agent calls join_group_order and
pays its own share with pay_order; at closing time the shop gets one combined order and the organiser gets its QR.
group_order_status shows who's in; close_group_order closes it early.
Questions about agentPickup itself rather than a shop: the user pays on the shop's own checkout, so the assistant and
agentPickup never see the card; the money goes to the shop; the shop sees the user's name and order, not their email;
an order nobody collects is refunded; shops join at https://agentpickup.app/connect, with their POS or with none.
More at https://agentpickup.app/faq.
stderr: agentPickup MCP · shop https://agentpickup.app · no wallet (pay_order returns the pay link)
